Construction Services in Rose Hill, KS

Rose Hill is a Butler County community of roughly 4,500 residents on the southwest edge of Butler County, near the Sedgwick County line south of Wichita. The area has grown steadily as families seeking Butler County schools, larger lots, and a smaller-community feel have moved into the Rose Hill USD 394 district. The housing stock is primarily newer construction — 1990s through 2010s subdivisions with poured-concrete basements and builder-grade finishes.

Wheatland Construction is based in El Dorado. Rose Hill is Butler County home territory. We permit through the City of Rose Hill for in-town properties and through Butler County for rural properties on county routes.

What We Build in Rose Hill

Custom Homes

Rose Hill's school district reputation drives demand for new custom home construction — families building on available lots within the district boundaries. We build custom homes in the Rose Hill area from foundation through finish, with Butler County or City of Rose Hill permits as appropriate. See Custom Home Building in Rose Hill →

Home Additions

Rose Hill's 1990s and 2000s homes were built at square footages that many families have outgrown. Master suite additions, room additions, and bonus room buildouts are practical investments in a growing community where home values support renovation spending. See Home Additions in Rose Hill →

Basement Finishing

Rose Hill's newer construction has full-depth poured-concrete basements — solid structural integrity, code-compliant rough-in plumbing, and enough square footage for meaningful living space. The southwest Butler County soil profile creates seasonal moisture pressure that we assess before framing starts. See Basement Finishing in Rose Hill →

Bathroom Remodeling

Rose Hill's builder-grade bathrooms from the 1990s and 2000s are now 20 to 30 years old and showing their age — yellowed fiberglass surrounds, cracked cultured marble, dated fixtures. We replace them completely with materials appropriate for long-term use. See Bathroom Remodeling in Rose Hill →

Kitchen Remodeling

Rose Hill kitchens from the subdivision buildout era have laminate countertops, basic cabinet boxes, and builder-grade lighting. We remodel them for how families actually use their kitchens — better layout where the original doesn't work, better storage, better lighting, and finishes that will last. See Kitchen Remodeling in Rose Hill →

Major Remodels

Some Rose Hill homeowners are tackling multiple rooms at once — kitchen, bathrooms, and primary suite in a single coordinated scope. We manage those projects with coordinated trades and a single contract. See Major Remodels in Rose Hill →

Roofing

Southwest Butler County sees significant spring hail activity. Rose Hill's newer construction has architectural shingles that have absorbed Kansas storms since the 1990s. We install new roofing systems and handle insurance documentation when applicable. See Roofing in Rose Hill →

Rose Hill Permit Jurisdiction

In-town Rose Hill properties permit through the City of Rose Hill. Rural properties outside city limits permit through Butler County. We handle all permits and inspections.
